business_scope.primary_industry_name: Public Commercial Web Scraping and Proxy API Gateways

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa (International Companies offshore regime under the International Companies Act 1987)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (English-colonial statutory heritage with Samoan customary law elements; unitary national system, no sub-state tax differentiation)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Samoa-China Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 3 October 2014; in force)
PACER Plus Regional Trade Agreement (in force since 2020)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement with Australia
Tax Information Exchange Agreement with New Zealand
Tax Information Exchange Agreement with the United States

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended), notably the International Companies Amendment Act 2018 (beneficial ownership register and disclosure duties); Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended) as the primary AML/CFT statute; SIFA AML/CFT Compliance Guidelines and Licensing Rules; International Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations 2019; UN sanctions are domestically implemented through the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 s.27 and associated designations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copy of passport of each UBO, director, and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in country of origin (passport issued by the relevant national passport authority)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization where the origin state is not party to the 1961 Hague Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public upstream of the issuing utility provider or bank

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original professional bank reference letter for each UBO / corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank of the UBO or, for corporate shareholders, a licensed corporate services provider

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Incumbency for each corporate shareholder in the ownership chain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Confidential UBO statutory declaration evidencing the full beneficial ownership chain and source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public; declarent is the proposed director or the registered agent's compliance officer

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT sanctions, and Samoa domestic designations. PEP screening is mandatory for the individual, immediate family members, and close associates; any PEP hit triggers enhanced due diligence (EDD) with source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification. Given the target payment rails (Stripe cards and USDC cryptocurrency), the crypto-asset channel is treated as a high-risk payment stream requiring additional EDD, wallet-source documentation, and ongoing transaction monitoring under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007. The commercial activity (web scraping and proxy API gateways) attracts a Medium_Risk_Enhanced banking-AML tier; accordingly the licensed registered agent must obtain an explanatory business-rationale memorandum, customer-risk assessment, and compliance-committee sign-off before incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SIFA - International Companies Registry (sifa.gov.ws; name reservation effected via the SIFA e-Registry or through a SIFA-licensed international company service provider)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be rendered in Latin/Roman script; English-language names are the norm for the offshore regime. Samoan-language names are permissible where written in Latin characters but are discouraged for international companies. There is no statutory transliteration requirement; foreign scripts (CJK, Cyrillic, Arabic) must be converted to a Roman-script rendering. The proposed name must not be identical or deceptively similar to any name on the Samoa domestic or international registries, must not imply a connection with the Samoan Government, and must comply with section 12 of the International Companies Act 1987.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Extension: before expiry, the applicant's licensed registered agent must file a written extension request with the Registrar of International Companies; the Registrar may grant one additional 30-day reservation. Rejection appeal: within 14 days of the refusal notice, the registered agent files a written appeal with the Registrar stating grounds of distinctiveness and compliance; the Registrar issues a determination within 21 days. A further refusal may be challenged by judicial review before the Supreme Court of Samoa.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as the statutory registered office. An International Company must maintain its registered office at the physically occupied premises of its SIFA-licensed registered agent in Samoa. A virtual mailbox may supplement but cannot replace the agent's physical office address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate. SIFA supervises licensed registered agents under a risk-based compliance program; unannounced inspections of registered agents occur with an estimated annual probability of not more than 15% affecting the relevant agent. Inspection of the client's foreign operational premises (servers, offices) is not expected where the International Company has no physical presence in Samoa; estimated probability below 5% for on-site visits to the data-pipeline operator's actual premises.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO register preparation and confidential filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: International Companies Amendment Act 2018 compliance; market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Enhanced KYC/EDD package - sanctions, PEP, adverse-media and international watchlist screening of UBOs and directors
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for AML/CFT compliance services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization plus apostille / consular legalization of the five-document KYC bundle

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariff plus apostille official fee
Sum of the itemized statutory tariffs and prevailing market charges

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended, ss. 5 (registered office), ss. 8-21 (incorporation), s. 37 (directors and officers), read with the International Companies Regulations 1998
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Companies Office, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation application (Form 1) together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up or authorized capital requirement under the International Companies Act 1987; the Company may issue a single US$1.00 share, fully paid on allotment, denominated in any currency; no mandatory escrow or capital deposit account is required
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, by the first directors, that: (1) the Memorandum and Articles of Association filed with the Registrar are adopted as the Company's constitutional documents; (2) the issue of one fully paid US$1.00 ordinary share to the initial subscriber is ratified and entered in the register of members; (3) the registered office is fixed at the registered office of Samoa Corporate Services Ltd, Apia, Samoa, and the registered agent is instructed to maintain it; (4) Anne Mateo is appointed sole director and John Pao is appointed secretary until the Board determines otherwise; and (5) the director is authorized to execute all incorporation documents and pay all filing fees and expenses.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Office, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online or in-person name clearance application requesting reservation of the proposed international company name. The name must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered name and must not contain prohibited words such as 'Assurance', 'Bank', 'Trust', or 'Government'. Upon approval, the name is reserved for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Copy of promoter or applicant identification document
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, submit up to three alternative names; appeal the refusal to the Registrar within 14 days with written submissions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent licensed under the International Companies Act 1987, with notarization by a notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association together with consents and appointments. The subscriber and each appointed director and secretary must execute the documents; the registered agent countersigns the registered office consent. If executed abroad, documents must be notarized and apostilled under the Hague Apostille Convention.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to act of each director and the secretary
Registered office consent of the licensed registered agent
Subscriber due diligence pack (passport, proof of address, source of funds)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct clerical errors and re-execute; re-notarize any instrument rejected for defective attestation before resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application to the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL Companies Office, Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the completed Form 1 application, the executed constitutional documents, and all consents with the Registrar. The application must be in English and must state the authorized share capital, registered office address, and particulars of the first director and secretary. The registered agent files the package on behalf of the Company.
required_dossiers: Appointment and consent of director and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to a Registrar requisition within 14 days by filing amended documents or supplementary declarations; if the application lapses, pay a nominal re-filing fee and resubmit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Finance Receipts Office / MCIL Corporate Payment Counter
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the official registration fee of US$750 by direct bank transfer to the Government of Samoa consolidated account or via the MCIL payment counter. The fee covers incorporation, the Certificate of Incorporation, and the first year of registration. Retain the official receipt for attachment to the application file.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request an official receipt reprint from the Ministry of Finance; reconcile any misapplied payment by written application supported by the bank confirmation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Post-Formation Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL Companies Office, Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the unique company number. The registered agent then opens the statutory registers, issues the share certificate, records the first board resolution in the minute book, and files the register of members and directors at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Share certificate issued to the subscriber
Minutes of the first board resolution
Register of members, directors, and charges
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Apply to the Registrar for re-issuance or correction of the certificate; file a rectification application with the Supreme Court of Samoa if the statutory record contains material errors.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) - Trade and Industry Division (advisory only; no mandatory industrial license for ISIC 6201)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Exempt - no statutory industrial operating or manufacturing license applies to public commercial web scraping and proxy API gateway services under the International Companies Act 1987

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) - Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA), Apia, Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Environmental Registration - office-based ICT data services do not trigger a full EIA under the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004; a simple environmental registration may be required for the office lease waste stream
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero process discharge; office wastewater must comply with municipal sewer discharge limits; e-waste from servers and workstations must be disposed through MNRE-approved recyclers; no VOC or hazardous waste thresholds triggered; diesel backup generators, if installed, must meet Samoa ambient air quality standards

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA) fire safety inspection and annual fire clearance for the Apia office; structural load compliance evidenced by the landlord's occupancy permit; occupational health and safety clearance under MCIL's Occupational Safety and Health Division covering electrical safety, workstations, and emergency evacuation plan

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Revenue (MfR), Independent State of Samoa (Matagaluega o Tupe Mau a le Malo); official online services portal: revenue.gov.ws / MfR e-Services (TIN verification, VAGST returns, customs ASYCUDA World declarations).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned international company (IC) is incorporated under the International Companies Act 2007 via a Samoa-licensed registered agent; the Registrar of International Companies (Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour) issues the Certificate of Incorporation and the Ministry of Revenue automatically assigns the TIN. The IC obtains a Standard Government Fee Certificate in lieu of tax filing; no income tax registration or annual return is required. VAGST registration is not required where the IC conducts only offshore API/proxy services; in the exceptional case of a permitted domestic taxable activity, a VAGST business registration form must be filed with MfR and a local fixed establishment designated.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid entity election exists under Samoa domestic law; the IC's tax-exempt status is mandatory, non-elective, and cannot be waived by election. Samoa has not adopted OECD hybrid mismatch or top-up tax elective regimes for ICs; fiscal transparency is determined solely under the shareholder's foreign tax law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax) — Goods and Services Tax Act 2003, as amended, administered by the Ministry of Revenue; Samoa Customs handles border enforcement.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 annual taxable turnover (mandatory registration); voluntary registration available for exporters and suppliers of zero-rated goods/services upon MfR application; economic nexus requirement enforced for any domestic taxable activity.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or e-invoicing API mandate is in force in Samoa; taxpayers issue MfR-compliant paper/PDF invoices and file VAGST returns via the MfR e-Services portal. ASYCUDA World provides electronic customs declarations but does not operate a continuous invoice clearance function.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A VAGST-registered exporter may zero-rate the export of goods or services where the goods are physically exported within the statutory period or the services are supplied to a non-resident for beneficial use wholly outside Samoa. A Samoan IC supplying API data pipelines, proxy gateways and scraping infrastructure to non-resident clients meets zero-rating criteria if the service is performed from Samoa infrastructure but the recipient, place of contract performance, and economic benefit are offshore; invoices must be issued to non-residents in foreign currency (commonly USD or USDC).
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration lodged via ASYCUDA World (Samoa Customs / MfR)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export of goods
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank credit advice demonstrating foreign-currency receipt
Executed service agreement with the non-resident counterparty
Zero-rated VAGST tax invoice identifying the non-resident recipient
Technical evidence of offshore supply (API access logs, gateway server records, proxy usage reports)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: False or unsupported zero-rating claims are treated as tax shortfalls under the Tax Administration Act 2012 and the Goods and Services Tax Act 2003: MfR may claw back refunded VAGST with interest and impose shortfall penalties up to 200% for deliberate evasion, plus monthly late-payment penalties for overdue amounts. Knowingly forged customs documents, bogus bills of lading or fictitious remittance certificates expose directors to criminal fines and imprisonment, deregistration of the IC, and indefinite reopening of assessments where fraud is proven.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), operating under the Exchange Control Act 1979, the Exchange Control Regulations 1980, and the Financial Institutions Act 1996
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan tala (WST) is not freely convertible. Current account payments are generally permitted through authorized-dealer commercial banks when supported by genuine underlying invoices, contracts, or audited financial statements. Capital account transactions, including the injection of foreign equity into an International Company, require prior CBS approval or an Exchange Control declaration routed through a licensed bank. Profit remittance hurdles include audited accounts, a CBS-specified foreign-remittance declaration, proof of good standing from the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), and an internal bank decision confirming that no ongoing Exchange Control obligation is breached. Although an International Company is tax-exempt, remittances are still subject to AML/CFT and wire-transfer compliance due diligence.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Samoa Exchange Control Regulations, resident exporters must repatriate export proceeds to an authorized-dealer bank in Samoa within 30 calendar days from the date of receipt. Mandatory conversion ratio is 100% into WST unless the Central Bank of Samoa grants a specific foreign-currency retention or exemption approval. For an International Company, a CBS exemption may be applied for through the local bank, but the default statutory timeline and conversion ratio remain the 30-day surrender rule and 100% conversion requirement. The authorized dealer must retain the export declaration, commercial invoice, bill of lading or service contract, and settlement proof for inspection.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account; capital escrow available only with CBS approval
Operational Account only; limited offshore/capital escrow services

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Samoa does not have a standalone e-money institution or fintech EMI licensing framework. Offshore digital EMIs cannot obtain settlement accounts at CBS or access Samoan clearing rails. A foreign EMI would need a banking licence under the Financial Institutions Act 1996, physical presence in Samoa, a local compliance officer, and SIFA recognition to offer account services to an International Company. Cryptocurrency flows such as USDC are not native settlement instruments for WST and cannot be cleared through CBS; they must be converted through a licensed money remitter or foreign exchange dealer outside Samoa before entering the banking system.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a medium-risk enhanced International Company engaged in cross-border API and web scraping commercialization, a physical KYC interview is the default requirement. At least one executive director or the ultimate beneficial owner must attend an in-person interview at the bank's Apia branch and present original certified identity documents, shareholder register excerpts, the International Company certificate of incorporation, SIFA certificate of good standing, and source-of-wealth evidence. Remote opening is not generally available as a standard procedure; any video-KYC exception would require senior management approval, enhanced due diligence, and a local trusted legal opinion certifying the identity and authority of the signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial ownership held through a Samoan International Company with a trust or layered ownership structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full UBO declaration; trust deed or corporate ownership diagram; register of directors and shareholders; nominee attestations; certified passports; SIFA certificate of good standing; signed board resolution authorizing account opening; and a legal opinion from a licensed Samoan attorney confirming that no bearer shares exist.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business activity classified as public commercial web scraping and proxy API gateways, which may be perceived as data-mining risk or IP infringement exposure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan; API product documentation; end-user licence agreement; scraping robustness and robots.txt compliance policy; target data-source contracts; data deletion and privacy law adherence; list of jurisdictions in which clients are located; sanctions screening policy; and data-flow diagrams showing no collection of personal or regulated data.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border receipts denominated in cryptocurrency USDC from API resellers, creating source-of-funds and sanctions concerns
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Wallet addresses and on-chain transaction history; exchange KYC records from the licensed crypto exchange; source-of-funds explanation; USDC issuer attestation or proof of conversion; AML/CFT risk assessment; no-use-of-mixer or privacy-wallet declaration; counterparty CIP files; and legal opinion on cryptocurrency treatment in the relevant foreign jurisdictions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High transaction velocity and multiple small-value remittances typical of data-pipeline API licensing monetisation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed subscriber agreements; scheduled pricing and metering records; API usage logs; commercial invoices; payment processor settlement statements; audited or reviewed financial statements; bank-statement explanations; and confirmation that transaction patterns match contracted metadata consumption rather than layering or unrelated payments.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity capital must be wired by the overseas parent or investor through SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 for bank-to-bank cover) to the Samoan authorized-dealer bank for credit to a dedicated Capital Escrow Account. The remittance instruction must quote the Samoan International Company's SIFA registration number, the CBS Exchange Control approval reference, and a purpose declaration corresponding to the BPM6 category of direct investment - equity capital. The receiving bank will verify the board resolution authorizing capital issuance, subscribed share schedule, source-of-funds statement, certificate of good standing, and the execution of the CBS Exchange Control form before releasing funds from escrow into the operational account. The foreign currency may be retained in a permissible USD denominated account only if the CBS retention approval has been granted; otherwise WST conversion is required at the prevailing authorized-dealer rate.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Cross-border trade and licensing disbursements should use SWIFT MT103 payments for high-volume API licensing settlements, and Commercial Letters of Credit (MT700/MT710) governed by UCP600 and ISBP 821 for larger contractual deliverables. All outbound transactions require an underlying commercial contract, invoice, and an authorized-dealer foreign-exchange declaration. Samoan banks route USD and third-currency payments through correspondent bank networks; WST is not an international clearing currency, so no direct offshore WST clearing exists. For crypto-denominated USDC disbursements, the International Company must first convert USDC to USD/EUR through a licensed exchange and then execute a compliant SWIFT payment to the beneficiary account; the bank will not clear USDC denominated direct settlements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain vanilla FX forwards booked with a CBS-licensed authorized dealer covering genuine committed trade, API licensing, or approved capital-account exposure.
Cross-currency swaps for tenor-matched conversion of foreign-currency debt or equity proceeds, subject to prior CBS Exchange Control approval and full underlying documentation.
Short-term FX swaps used to cover working-capital mismatches between USDC/USD receivables and WST or other settlement currencies.
NDFs are not permissible for the WST onshore market because the Samoan tala remains deliverable through authorized dealers and CBS does not maintain a licensed non-deliverable forward framework.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on or before each anniversary of the date of incorporation; no grace period for International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of USD 50 per month or part thereof; continued non-compliance for 6 months may trigger a 30-day strike-off notice and ultimate removal from the International Companies Register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government License Fee (included in the Annual Return filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable annually in advance, on the anniversary of incorporation, together with the Annual Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-payment of the annual license fee incurs a penalty of 10% of the outstanding fee after 30 days; after 90 days the Registrar may administratively strike off the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership and Shareholder Confirmation Statement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies via the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted concurrently with the Annual Return on the anniversary date, covering changes during the preceding 12-month period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: False or incomplete confirmation carries fines up to WST 1,000 (approx. USD 370) and may suspend the company's good-standing certificate for banking or licensing purposes.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit applies only to licensed banks, insurance companies, or trust licensees. An ordinary International Company engaged in commercial data scraping API services is audit-exempt, regardless of revenue or asset levels; no quantitative threshold is prescribed in the International Companies Act 1987.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by the Samoa Institute of Chartered Accountants (SICA). Audited financial statements, when voluntarily prepared, must comply with IFRS; there is no statutory obligation to file accounts with the Registrar for a non-licensed International Company.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The International Company must maintain at the registered office a register of members and a register of beneficial owners. On the annual return anniversary, the registered agent must confirm that all current shareholders and beneficial owners are accurately recorded. Any share transfer during the year must be entered into the register of members before the annual return is filed; the signed annual return serves as the annual UBO confirmation.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 – USD 5,500 (only if voluntarily audited or license-triggered)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% for Samoan International Companies (ICs). Under Section 197 of the International Companies Act 1987 (as amended), an IC is exempt from all Samoan taxes, duties, rates, and levies on its income, profits, distributions, capital gains, and transactions, provided it does not carry on business in Samoa, does not hold Samoan land, and is not beneficially owned by Samoan residents. No capital gains tax applies to share disposals, and no stamp duty or estate duty is levied on IC instruments. The income tax exemption does not extend to VAGST (15%) on on-island supplies of goods or services. The standard 27% rate applies only where the IC breaches the on-shore business prohibition and becomes assessable on domestic-source income.
